# Coffee Maker Comparison for Small Apartments

## Feature Comparison Table

| Space | Medium to large | Small | Small to medium |
| Setup | Easy | Manual | Very easy |

| Coffee Quality | Consistent | Rich and full-bodied | Convenient but varies |

# Mortgage Payment Estimate
For a 450,000 USD fixed-rate mortgage at 6.5 percent over 30 years, the estimated monthly payment is 2,842.25 USD before taxes and insurance.

## Payment Variables and Totals
| Item | Description | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P | Principal loan amount | $450,000 |
| i | Monthly interest rate | 0.00541667 |
| n | Total payments | 360 |
| M | Monthly payment | $2,842.25 |
| Total Interest | Interest paid over 30 years | $573,210.00 |

## Formula
M = P * i(1+i)^n / ((1+i)^n - 1). This excludes tax, insurance, HOA fees, and closing costs.

# Fix npm EACCES Permission Errors
EACCES means npm cannot write to the target directory. Prefer a user-level Node manager before changing ownership of system folders.

## Safe Troubleshooting Steps
| Step | Command | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | npm config get prefix | Shows global npm path |
| 2 | whoami | Confirms current user |
| 3 | nvm install node | Installs Node in user space |
| 4 | npm cache clean --force | Clears locked cache entries |
| 5 | npm install | Package installs without EACCES |

## Recommended Fix
Use NVM or another version manager. Avoid sudo npm install because it creates more ownership conflicts later.

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Open NVM Guide] https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm#installing-and-updating

## Sources
- npm Docs: https://docs.npmjs.com/resolving-eacces-permissions-errors-when-installing-packages-globally
